headline: Looking for something to do this weekend? Here are the Top 5 local events for Sept. 19-20
teaser: Boat bargains, a family barn dance, country music in Vero Beach, a Stuart riverfront concert and a Lynyrd Skynyrd tribute are among this weekend's options.
body:
Looking for something to do on the Treasure Coast this weekend? We pulled five standout picks from Saturday, Sept. 19, and Sunday, Sept. 20, spanning St. Lucie, Indian River and Martin counties.

Schedules and admission details can change, so check the individual event page before heading out.

## 1. Marine Flea Market and Boat Sale — Port St. Lucie

**Saturday, Sept. 19, 9 a.m.-5 p.m. | MIDFLORIDA Event Center, 9221 SE Event Center Place**

The Marine Flea Market and Boat Sale is built for boaters, anglers and anyone who likes browsing coastal gear. The event listing advertises new and used boats, fishing seminars and workshops, U.S. Coast Guard participation, seafood, beach music, marine bargains and closeout fishing and boating gear.

[View the Marine Flea Market and Boat Sale event page](https://treasurecoast.today/events/fa38627ef8ff7a0325-marine-flea-market-and-boat-sale.html).

## 2. Bullfrogs & Butterflies Family Barn Dance — Fort Pierce

**Saturday, Sept. 19, 1-4 p.m. | GraceWay Village, 1780 Hartman Road**

GraceWay Village is expanding its long-running Butterfly Kisses Father-Daughter Dance into the Bullfrogs & Butterflies Family Barn Dance. The organization says the original dance has raised critical funds for 12 years, while this year's event broadens the afternoon to families.

[View the Bullfrogs & Butterflies Family Barn Dance event page](https://treasurecoast.today/events/06bfa77d7c04046178-bullfrogs-butterflies-family-barn-dance.html).

## 3. Joe Reid & Heartland Band — Vero Beach

**Saturday, Sept. 19, 5:30-8:30 p.m. | Riverside Theatre, 3250 Riverside Park Drive**

For a Saturday evening music option in Indian River County, Riverside Theatre has Joe Reid & Heartland Band on its calendar for a three-hour country performance.

[View the Joe Reid & Heartland Band event page](https://treasurecoast.today/events/24949dd0223ea58fb5-joe-reid-heartland-band.html).

## 4. Rock'n Riverwalk — Stuart

**Sunday, Sept. 20, 1-4 p.m. | Riverwalk Stage, 121 SW Flagler Avenue**

Rock'n Riverwalk returns Sunday afternoon at the Riverwalk Stage in downtown Stuart. The City of Stuart calendar lists the live-music event from 1 to 4 p.m., making it an easy daytime option before the weekend winds down.

[View the Rock'n Riverwalk event page](https://treasurecoast.today/events/241c00287ea781a22e-rock-n-riverwalk.html).

## 5. The Artimus Pyle Band — Stuart

**Sunday, Sept. 20, 7 p.m. | The Lyric Theatre, 59 SW Flagler Avenue | $60**

The Lyric Theatre closes out the weekend with The Artimus Pyle Band, honoring Ronnie Van Zant's Lynyrd Skynyrd. The event listing describes Pyle as the last surviving member and drummer of the classic Lynyrd Skynyrd lineup and notes his 2006 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction with the band.

[View The Artimus Pyle Band event page](https://treasurecoast.today/events/d4a9d6f4ce5f25c671-the-artimus-pyle-band-honoring-ronnie-van-zant-s-lynyrd-skynyrd.html).

## More things to do

These are five of the events happening around the Treasure Coast this weekend. Browse the full [Treasure Coast Today events calendar](https://treasurecoast.today/events.html) for more options in Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties.
